[USER] User asked if the way ancient Egyptians walked was different from the way more modern Egyptians like Cleopatra walked.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated it is difficult to say with certainty how ancient Egyptians walked due to lack of direct evidence, but cultural influences, lifestyle changes, and factors like footwear and clothing could lead to differences in gait.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that ancient Egyptian footwear often consisted of sandals or bare feet, which may have influenced their walking style.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that ancient Egyptian culture spanned thousands of years and underwent many changes, which could have affected walking styles over time.
